title: Correct Lagrangian
description: Essential Criteria: The Lagrangian must be correctly expressed as L = (1/2) m (dot(r)^2 + r^2 dot(theta)^2) + k/r.

title: Correct equations of motion
description: Important Criteria: The equations of motion derived from the Lagrangian must be correctly stated as m*ddot(r) + k/r^2 = 0 and d/dt(m*r^2*dot(theta)) = 0.

title: First integral identified
description: Essential Criteria: The first integral must be correctly identified as mr^2*dot(theta) = constant.

title: Correct potential energy
description: Important Criteria: The potential energy must be correctly derived as V = -k/r.

title: Sign errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common sign mistakes in the equations of motion or Lagrangian.

title: Units consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Ensure that all terms in the Lagrangian and equations of motion have consistent units.
